ui_bugs.issue: Kiosk URL omits the ?c=<slug> query param when localStorage 'pwa_company_slug' is empty. Admin login via /login form does NOT set this localStorage key (only ?c= visits and subdomain visits do). Observed: anchor href was 'https://vastgoed-app.preview.emergentagent.com/kiosk/huurder' instead of '.../kiosk/huurder?c=surirent'. The admin-supplied link therefore won't auto-resolve branding on a fresh device — tenant will land on CompanyPicker. Fix: derive slug from auth context (e.g. company.slug returned by /api/auth/me) as primary source, fall back to localStorage. The AdminDashboard already has `company` from useAuth — just pass it down.

rca of the issue: TenantPinModal builds the kiosk URL with `localStorage.getItem('pwa_company_slug')`. Per /app/frontend/src/lib/branding.js this key is only persisted by setStoredSlug() which is called when the kiosk PWA detects a slug from ?c= or subdomain. Admin who logs in via /login form on the bare preview URL never triggers this path → localStorage stays empty → modal URL falls back to '/kiosk/huurder' (no slug). Mitigation: pass the admin's own company slug (already available from /api/auth/me as `company.slug`) into TenantPinModal as a prop.
